per_phase_nfrs.phase_name: Target Market Assessment and Fair Value Check

security.data_classification: PII — customer profile, age, insurance eligibility
security.audit: Target market assessment result and fair value check logged with timestamp (FCA PROD evidence)

security.access_control: SCA for high-value commitments; IPID acknowledgement timestamp serves as evidence of informed consent
security.audit: Policy binding with underwriter_policy_ref logged immutably

per_phase_nfrs.phase_name: Account Fee Update and Consumer Duty Recording

security.access_control: System-initiated account update post policy binding
security.audit: Consumer Duty evidence trail saved with all assessment results

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Insurance Policy Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: InsurancePolicy records (including Consumer Duty evidence, target market assessment, IPID acknowledgement) retained for minimum 6 years after policy end date.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: FCA ICOBS record retention requirements; Consumer Duty evidence for FCA review; limitation period for mis-selling claims.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Consumer Duty Evidence — Mandatory
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Every insurance distribution must have a documented Consumer Duty evidence trail: target market assessment result, fair value assessment result, IPID acknowledgement timestamp, and policy binding confirmation.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: FCA PROD 4 (insurance product oversight) requires documented evidence that the product was distributed to customers within the target market and provides fair value.

regulatory_slas.name: ICOBS — IPID Before Conclusion of Contract
regulatory_slas.requirement: The IPID (Insurance Product Information Document) must be provided to the customer before the insurance contract is concluded.
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Contract may be voidable; FCA enforcement; reputational damage (PPI mis-selling history)

regulatory_slas.name: FCA PROD — Target Market Assessment
regulatory_slas.requirement: Insurance products must only be distributed to customers within the defined target market. Target market assessment must be documented.
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: FCA enforcement; potential product intervention order; customer redress obligation
